name: dobe_backhug_key
desc: Seen from behind: the goo Doberman is tightly hugging someone in front of it who is completely hidden by its huge body. Its broad muscular back fills the view, shoulders hunched forward, both thick arms wrapped forward around the hidden person so only the upper arms and elbows show at the sides, head tilted down and to the side nuzzling, sticky goo dripping down its back. Same colors, yellow marble streaks, outline and pixel art style, puddle base.
